translationRepairs: Two years later, Liu Ze sent a messenger to tell Tian Sheng: 'I will not help you anymore.'
In the second year, Liu Ze sent a messenger to tell Tian Sheng: 'I will not help you anymore.'

In this annalistic stretch, 二年 is the second year of the reign already in force (高后時), not a relative span after the gold gift; "Two years later" misreads the dating formula, and "In the second year" restores it.
The Han King then commanded Liu Jia to lead the Jiujiang troops southwest with Grand Marshal Lu Wan to attack King Linjiang Gong Wei.
The Han King then commanded Liu Jia to lead the Jiujiang troops southwest with Grand Commandant Lu Wan to attack King Linjiang Gong Wei.
The unit has 太尉盧綰, while s0006 has 大司馬周殷; Grand Marshal for 太尉 conflates the offices, and Grand Commandant matches 太尉 and the idiomatic of this same unit.

Dingguo wished to have an official killed—the magistrate of Feiru, a man from Ying. When this man and others reported Dingguo's crimes, Dingguo had the court usher bring trumped-up charges against them, arresting and killing the man from Ying to silence him.

Dingguo wished to have an official killed—Yingren, the magistrate of Feiru. When Yingren and others reported Dingguo's crimes, Dingguo had the court usher bring trumped-up charges against them, arresting and killing Yingren to silence him.

肥如令郢人 names the official 郢人 (Yingren), not a demonym "man from Ying"; the proposal is right on that point but awkwardly rewrites the verb and drops the em-dash apposition, so the repair keeps the original phrasing while substituting the personal name throughout.
